premise: All humans vanish simultaneously with no cause specified; initial objects, animals, plants, weather and machines remain. No bodies, later survivors or autonomous caretaker civilization assumed.
time_scope: Windows for processes, not exact universal dates or site-specific engineering forecasts.
power: Supply-demand balance, automatic controls, protection, fuel and maintenance cause varied regional outcomes. Renewable resource does not mean indefinitely functioning equipment.
water: Gravity storage and pumped systems differ; pressure, treatment and wastewater quality have separate failure modes. Local groundwater, rain and drainage affect tunnels.
animals: No universal survival ranking by breed. Confinement, access, health, traits, environment and chance matter. Scout's gate was already open; eventual survival not promised.
named_pet_chronology: Scout and Juniper only first-days/opening-day and explicit ending rewind. Later feral animals are different individuals/generations.
nuclear: Stopping chain reaction does not eliminate decay heat. Pools, suitable dry storage, active cooling and passive heat rejection differ. Conditional local accidents, not inevitable identical failures or weapon detonations.
weathering: Corrosion, roof/drainage failure, wet-dry exposure, salts, freeze-thaw and existing condition matter. No common year every building or dam collapses.
ecology: No instant mature forest or universal succession endpoint. Wildlife abundance does not demonstrate individual health or harmless contamination. Extinction and introductions are not automatically undone.
climate: Ending emissions does not instantly restore preindustrial temperature. Carbon, ocean heat, ice, aerosols, land use and other changes have different response times.
materials: Plastic fragmentation differs from full chemical disappearance. Preservation and geological detectability are conditional and patchy, not a guaranteed intact fossil city.
space: Low-orbit drag differs from high-orbit persistence. Lunar surfaces lack Earth-like atmospheric weather but impacts and space weathering occur. Do not draw atmospheric meteor streaks in lunar sky. Artifact survival differs from functioning transmission and readable knowledge.
thumbnail: Overgrown city and deer symbolize a long interval after disappearance, not the next morning.
curation: Final source07/cell12 and source34/cell12 breed rankings excluded; source29/cell5 and source41/cell11 lunar meteor trails excluded; source31/cell10 mammoth excluded. Use final shots and curation notes.
